jobInfo.jobTitle: Paraprofessional (High School) w/great benefits & tuition payments
jobInfo.jobDescription:
Thank you for considering employment in the Lunenburg Public Schools.
The mission of The Lunenburg Public Schools is to provide all students with the skills, confidence, and passion for life-long learning so that they may find their own paths to successful careers, active citizenship, and rewarding lives.

There are open Paraprofessional positions at the Lunenburg High School.

TITLE: Paraprofessional
REPORTS TO: Principal

BENEFITS
*School year position - vacation weeks and summer off
*Summer work opportunities, if wanted
•9 paid holidays, paid sick leave and personal leave; 12 sick days, 3 personal days 
•Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance (75% employer, 25% employee)
•Tuition Reimbursement (up to $600 per undergraduate class, up to $900 per graduate class)
•Career Advancement and Professional Development
*Employee contributions to 403b TSA.

LOCATION
Lunenburg High School (9-12), 1079 Massachusetts Ave, Lunenburg, MA  01462

DESCRIPTION
Paraprofessional designated as highly qualified by the Massachusetts Department of Elementary and Secondary Education sought to assist students with and without special needs. The successful candidate will possess knowledge/experience working with students with various learning styles and be able to support a variety of behaviors. 

REQUIREMENTS:
The position entails working well as a team member and working closely with the special education teacher and other support services. 

WORK DAY
32.5 hours a week.
jobInfo.requirements:
If not licensed, then a Highly Qualified Status entails: 
Hold a high school diploma (or equivalent) and meet one of the following:

1.Obtain an associate’s (or higher) degree OR 
2.Complete at least two years of study at an institute of higher education OR 
3.Demonstrate, through a formal state or local academic assessment, knowledge of reading, writing, math, and the ability to assist in instructing these subjects. 

States and local school districts have adopted a variety of academic assessments that do not necessarily have to be a “paper-and-pencil” test. The ParaPro Assessment is one of many tests that paraprofessionals can take to become highly qualified. 


TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT:
Salary per Lunenburg Paraprofessional Union Contract.
Hiring is subject to satisfactory CORI and SAFIS Background Checks per 603 CMR 51.

OTHER:
This posting will remain open until a qualified applicant is found.


NONDISCRIMINATION STATEMENT:

Additionally, we prohibit retaliation against individuals who oppose such discrimination and harassment or who participate in an equal opportunity investigation.
